column3: 画面内容
一个略显质朴的房间，轻薄的纱窗，阳光照射进来
Luna推开门跑了进来，手里抱着一束花和药袋，直接跑向床上的人
镜头上移，床上的人是憔悴的Iris，目光看着Luna，带着慈爱的微笑
Luna把东西放在床头，懂事乖巧地说
column8: Luna (rushing to the bedside, looking up): Mama, are you feeling better today?

column3: Iris伸出手，抚摸着Luna的头，动作有些缓慢，说
家庭医生Theo站在窗边，他的笑容温暖，看向Luna说
column8: Theo (smiling): Luna is such a good girl. There are a few medications your mama needs from the pharmacy — can you go pick them up for me?

column3: Theo对着Luna，微笑着说，递给了Luna一张处方单
column8: Theo (smiling): Luna is such a good girl. There are a few medications your mama needs from the pharmacy — can you go pick them up for me?

column3: Luna活力地点点头，接过处方单，紧紧攥住它，转身便跑
Iris看着Luna跑出去，温柔地说
column8: Iris (calling after her softly): Look both ways when you cross the street.

column3: Luna头也不回，直接跑走
column8: Luna (not looking back, small and confident): I know, Mama!

column3: 门关上了，Theo和Iris互相对视了一眼，Iris的笑容逐渐消失，Theo只是低头抬叹气
小镇街道上，人来人往
Luna的小短腿快速走着，镜头上摇，摇到Luna哼着歌
红灯
Luna朝着人行道走去，背景里还是那辆库里南，飞驰而来
车轮急刹
库里南在Luna面前稳稳地停下来，Luna被吓得后退了两步，处方掉在了地上
Luna捡起处方单，吹了吹上面的灰，她只是皱了皱眉头。背景中两个人从车上下来，关上车门，快步走向她
一双高级皮鞋踏入镜头
column8: Caius (crouching down, something suppressed in his voice): Are you alright, little one?

column3: Luna抬头看
Caius平静的看着Luna，身后是喘着粗气的Dante
Luna眨了眨眼，说
column8: Luna (looking up at him, calm — the way a certain someone is calm): I'm fine.

column3: Caius低头看着Luna，他微微皱眉
Caius和Dante交换了一下眼神，然后对着Luna继续说
column8: Caius (still crouching, softening his tone): Let me cover any medical expenses. Where are your parents?

column3: Luna低头看了看手里的处方单，摇了摇头，说
column8: Luna (shaking her head, hugging the slip): I'm fine. I need to go find my mama.

column3: Caius蹲了下来，说
Luna退后一步，怯怯地说
column8: Luna (matter-of-fact): That's okay. My house is close. And Mama says I shouldn't go anywhere with strangers.

column3: Caius顿了一下，然后点了点头说
column8: Caius ( nodding): Alright. Be careful out there.

column3: Luna点了点头，转身跑开
Caius站起来，看向Dante说着话（慢动作，街道的背景声）
Luna跑着，项链从脖子上滑动出来，是Iris的项链，却只剩下了一半
Caius说完，看向了Luna的方向
街道上已没了Luna的身影
Dante看向Caius，有些疑惑地说
Caius微微皱起眉头，说
column8: Caius (thoughtful): That child... gave me a feeling I can't place.

column3: Dante单手拿出手机，看了看讯息，严肃地对着Caius说
column8: Dante (low): Alpha — new lead. The Madam's presence has been traced to this town.

column3: Caius猛然转过头看着Dante

Caius伸手从领口拉出一条项链，那是图腾的另一半
（回忆：Iris在床上，将项链的另一半交给了Caius）
Caius攥着项链，像是自言自语地说
column8: Caius (gripping the necklace, barely above a whisper): Iris... this time, I will find you.
